tasks.title: Add GET /api/overview/summary route
tasks.notes: app/api/overview.py, same router as program-detail (already registered in app.main -- no wiring edit needed there). Handler order, deliberate (FR-3): (1) await org_access(current_user) -- 403 no data body for non-cio, logs rbac_check_org_access (AC-3/AC-8); (2) await FreshnessAccessor().get_last_successful_run() -- constructed fresh per request (no app.state singleton, per freshness-api's own contract note; R-04 accepted, document the per-request-cache-miss limitation in this docstring); this call is UNCONDITIONED by the rollup lookup below -- its HTTPException(500, 'ingestion job may not have run yet') propagates even when the rollup row is absent too (AC-7, the fully-fresh-DB case); (3) select(OrgSummaryRollup).where(org_id=='org-1'); row is None -> all-zero OrgSummaryResponse (cards values '0 / 0'/'0'/'0'/'0'/'0' -- the ratio is card 1, programs_using_ai={count:0,total:0,adoption_percent:None}) (AC-2); row present -> compute_adoption_percent(row) (api-conventions) + _build_org_summary_cards(row, computed) using the 5 fixed (glyph,label) pairs from DECISIONS.md D-01, CORRECTED 2026-09-10 per D-02 -- the ratio is on card 1, not card 5: card 1 value=f'{programs_using_ai_count} / {programs_total}' exempt from format_number(), and card 1 sub=f'{round(adoption_percent)}% adoption' (null when programs_total==0, since adoption_percent is None then and the sc-if omits the element); cards 2-5 value=format_number() and sub=None -- card 5 is a PLAIN count, not a ratio. Module/route docstring notes (Documentation requirements): (a) no freshness timestamp renders anywhere on this page (AC-6 backend-only, guard against a future 'helpful' addition), (b) the freshness/rollup ordering independence (FR-3), (c) AUTH-03's open security review caveat (Condition 1) -- this docstring is what the PR body should quote/carry forward, not a merge blocker.
